apps.videofix.benefit: Convert HDR, HEVC and Apple Log video
apps.videofix.access: The first 3 conversions are free. Lifetime and auto-renewing monthly purchases unlock unlimited conversions.
apps.videofix.caveat: Conversion re-encodes the video. Keep the original and check playback, sound and color in the intended destination.
apps.videofix.feature.0: Map HDR video to standard Rec.709 SDR color.
apps.videofix.feature.1: Convert HEVC to an H.264 MP4, including HEVC that is already SDR.
apps.videofix.feature.2: Convert Apple ProRes Log to Rec.709 SDR.
apps.videofix.feature.3: Choose a steady 24, 25, 30 or 60 FPS export and process several clips.
apps.videofix.feature.4: Choose output resolution, set an optional maximum size, or extract AAC audio as M4A.
apps.audio-compressor.access: One successful export is included. Recording and playback are free. Further exports and Pro tools require Lifetime or an auto-renewing Monthly plan. Failed or cancelled exports do not use the allowance.
apps.audio-compressor.caveat: File compression changes encoded size. It is different from reducing the dynamic range of a recording.
apps.audio-compressor.feature.0: Compress MP3, M4A, WAV, AAC and other supported audio files.
apps.audio-compressor.feature.1: Convert audio, extract sound from video and cut clips.
apps.audio-compressor.feature.2: Use pitch, tempo and metronome tools.
apps.audio-compressor.feature.3: Compress audio files and choose the output quality.
apps.collage-maker.benefit: Stitch screenshots or make a photo grid
apps.collage-maker.access: One free export is included and every layout is available. Lifetime or monthly Pro unlocks unlimited exports.
apps.collage-maker.caveat: Processing stays on your device. The current store listing says no accounts, ads or watermarks.
apps.collage-maker.feature.0: Combine 2 to 30 selected photos or screenshots.
apps.collage-maker.feature.1: Choose among 11 layouts, including grids and side-by-side arrangements.
apps.collage-maker.feature.2: Move and zoom photos, then export JPEG or PNG up to 3000 pixels wide.
apps.collage-maker.feature.3: Save to Photos, share with another app, or find the finished image in Files.
apps.pdf-compressor.benefit: Make PDFs smaller and finish document tasks
apps.pdf-compressor.access: PDF Compressor Pro unlocks export tools with lifetime or auto-renewing monthly access. Check the store and in-app offer.
apps.pdf-compressor.caveat: Compression may create image-backed pages and remove selectable text, forms, links, annotations, layers or metadata. Keep the original and inspect the exported copy.
apps.pdf-compressor.feature.0: Compress one PDF or batch compress up to 50 PDFs.
apps.pdf-compressor.feature.1: Inspect the estimated output size before export and the actual saving afterward.
apps.pdf-compressor.feature.2: Scan documents, reorder or rotate pages, sign, watermark and merge PDFs.
apps.pdf-compressor.feature.3: Combine JPEG images into a PDF or export PDF pages as JPEG.
apps.pdf-watermarker.benefit: Add a visible purpose mark to a PDF
apps.pdf-watermarker.access: PDF Watermark Pro unlocks the export tools with lifetime or auto-renewing monthly access.
apps.pdf-watermarker.caveat: A visible watermark identifies a copy. It does not encrypt the file or prevent every edit or redistribution.
apps.pdf-watermarker.feature.0: Select a PDF from Files and write your watermark text.
apps.pdf-watermarker.feature.1: Choose repeated diagonal marks or a centered stamp.
apps.pdf-watermarker.feature.2: Adjust text, opacity, size and color, and preview the pages.
apps.pdf-watermarker.feature.3: Export a new marked copy while retaining the original.
apps.glowpop.benefit: Use screen light for selfies and video
apps.glowpop.access: Preview light colors for free. The first 5 photos are free, including white-light photos. Lifetime or monthly Pro unlocks unlimited photos and video.
apps.glowpop.caveat: Screen fill light changes the lighting around the front camera. Results depend on the device, distance and room light.
apps.glowpop.feature.0: Preview adjustable screen-light colors with the front camera open.
apps.glowpop.feature.1: Adjust brightness and use the selfie mirror.
apps.glowpop.feature.2: Capture photos and save them to the app album and Photos.
apps.glowpop.feature.3: Pro includes unlimited photos and video recording.
apps.just-captions.benefit: Add captions, word highlights and emojis
apps.just-captions.access: Free single-video exports have a Just Captions watermark. One single-video Emoji export is available to try. Pro adds batch captions, locked styles, higher export quality and 600 AI caption minutes per month.
apps.just-captions.caveat: Core caption generation can run on device. Optional online AI text tools send caption text after consent; they are different from the local caption workflow.
apps.just-captions.feature.0: Generate speech captions, review the transcript and edit the words.
apps.just-captions.feature.1: Use emoji matching, animated caption styles and word highlights.
apps.just-captions.feature.2: With Pro, caption up to 20 videos in a batch.
apps.just-captions.feature.3: Use optional AI Correct and AI Translate, with consent, and export video or SRT text.
apps.dying-soon.benefit: Set screen-time limits and mindful reminders
apps.dying-soon.access: Check the current App Store listing and in-app offer for access and purchase options.
apps.dying-soon.caveat: Countdowns and grids are personal reflection tools. They are not predictions of an individual lifespan.
apps.dying-soon.feature.0: Choose apps to block and use app limits or schedules.
apps.dying-soon.feature.1: Use memento mori reminders and a configurable life-grid view.
apps.dying-soon.feature.2: Set daily notifications and collect reflection quotes.
apps.dying-soon.feature.3: The current update adds temporary unlocks from the block screen.
apps.vidkit.benefit: Compress videos and convert MP4, HEVC or MOV
apps.vidkit.access: Video Compressor Pro unlocks the export tools with lifetime or auto-renewing monthly access.
apps.vidkit.caveat: Compression and conversion re-encode media. A smaller file does not by itself solve HDR color or every upload error.
apps.vidkit.feature.0: Convert HEVC to MP4/H.264 for a more compatible copy.
apps.vidkit.feature.1: Convert MP4/H.264 to HEVC or export a MOV copy.
apps.vidkit.feature.2: Reduce video size and compare the original and exported sizes.
apps.vidkit.feature.3: With Pro, batch compress videos, change speed or export a looping GIF up to 15 seconds.
apps.vidkit.feature.4: Compress photos as an additional tool.
apps.photofix.benefit: Convert HDR, HEIC and RAW photos
apps.photofix.access: The first 3 successful photo conversions are free. Every photo in a batch uses one conversion. Lifetime and monthly purchases unlock unlimited conversions.
apps.photofix.caveat: Normal-to-HDR cannot recover detail already lost. HDR brightness depends on the display. JPEG replaces transparency with white; PNG can preserve it.
apps.photofix.feature.0: Map HDR highlights into an SDR photo for ordinary sharing.
apps.photofix.feature.1: Convert HEIC or device-compatible RAW photos to JPEG, or export PNG.
apps.photofix.feature.2: Apply a creative normal-to-HDR brightness effect.
apps.photofix.feature.3: Process batches and choose whether to retain capture date and location.
apps.photofix.feature.4: Keep Live Photo motion for normal SDR export; HDR export creates a still photo.
apps.sober-wins.benefit: Track alcohol-free days with Sober Wins
apps.sober-wins.access: Basic tracking, history, collectibles, the mini fridge and basic sharing are free. Lifetime is a one-time purchase. Annual and Monthly subscriptions renew automatically until cancelled in Apple Account settings. Lifetime does not cancel an existing subscription.
apps.sober-wins.caveat: Health trends are not medical advice or proof of cause. Virtual collectibles have no cash or alcohol redemption value.
apps.sober-wins.feature.0: Log alcohol-free days and review the local history.
apps.sober-wins.feature.1: Collect virtual items, arrange the mini fridge and take a breathing pause.
apps.sober-wins.feature.2: Optionally read sleep and resting-heart-rate trends from Apple Health.
apps.sober-wins.feature.3: Pro adds premium cabinets, poster export and a daily collection boost.
common.analytics_text: Allow optional analytics? PostHog helps Space Sheep Studio understand page visits and download clicks. We do not record sessions, form contents, or your files.
